text:
sarah_marketing: heads up — aiming to land the release announce on Tues 10:00 PT. Need final changelog, docs links, and a short benchmark blurb by EOD tomorrow. can we lock timing? :calendar:

jamal_eng: can confirm changelog PR will be merged by EOD tomorrow. docs have a draft but need a quick review from product. pinging @maria_product

maria_product: thanks @jamal_eng — i'll review docs today, expect comments by 3pm PT. webinar scheduling question: is Wed 11am PT still on the table or do we keep it post-launch?

sarah_marketing: prefer Wed 11am so we capture immediate momentum. marketing wants 24–48h post-announce touchpoints. if any infra risk, we can move to Thurs.

lina_marketing: i'll prep social copy + newsletter snippet once changelog link is final. can someone post a one-paragraph benchmark takeaway for the 280-character teaser?

jamal_eng: benchmark summary (draft): "Redwood Inference reduces median text-gen latency by ~22% at 512 tokens vs baseline; ~30% cost reduction with default batching + KV cache." use as shortline and we'll refine numbers in the blog.

patrick_release: FYI release plan: canary rollout 10:00–12:00 PT, full ramp 12:15. we need the announcement embargo to lift at 10:05 PT so telemetry dashboards can show initial traffic without confusing users. deploy-bot will run the canary job at 09:50 PT for prechecks.

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary job set: canary-window start=2026-07-14T09:50:00Z, deploy-target=canary-pool-3, notify=#eng-oncall if fail.

jamal_eng: quick note — docs link will be: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-07-inference-update (placeholder until final slug). changelog PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/changelog/pull/482

sarah_marketing: perfect. marketing asks that changelog has a "What this means for users" bullet. can we add 2 lines on migration/compatibility (if any) and an example snippet?

jamal_eng: will add 2 bullets and an example curl snippet in the changelog. example: ```bash
curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN' -d '{"model":"rw1-large","prompt":"hello"}'
```

maria_product: for the webinar, i'd like a short slide on Canary + rollback story (1 slide) — shows the safe rollout. @patrick_release can you provide 2 bullet points on rollback criteria?

patrick_release: rollback criteria: 1) error rate > 1% sustained for 5 minutes, 2) latency P95 > 2x baseline for 10 minutes. will write exact wording and drop into the doc by 5pm PT.

lina_marketing: social copy draft incoming. will include benchmark blurb + docs link + webinar CTA. would like to run the first draft by eng for accuracy before scheduling posts.

sarah_marketing: timeline recap: EOD tomorrow = changelog merged + docs reviewed, 09:50 PT canary precheck, 10:00 PT announce embargo lift at 10:05 PT, webinar Wed 11am PT. if everyone confirms in this thread i'll lock the calendar and schedule posts. :white_check_mark:

jamal_eng: confirmed from eng side. merging changelog + adding snippet now.

maria_product: confirmed. i'll drop webinar slides (canary + rollback) in the shared drive and notify here when ready.

lina_marketing: confirmed — once i get final links i'll schedule the social queue and newsletter.

sarah_marketing: thanks all. last ask: if any numbers change, please update this thread with an explicit "update:" prefix so we don't ship wrong metrics.

jamal_eng: update: final benchmark delta changed to 20% median latency improvement after last perf pass. updating PR now.

lina_marketing: got it — will use the updated 20% number. schedule still on. :rocket:
